tool_action.public_message: No on the swap. Mortgaged Boardwalk doesn't help me, and New York is the piece you actually need. Counter: Park Place plus $200 for St. James and Tennessee. You get dark blue and cash to lift Boardwalk. I eat the unmortgage bill on two dead oranges. That's a real second monopoly against p3 — your swap isn't, for me.
tool_action.private_thought: Hail-mary counter: PP+$200 for both oranges. If accepted, cash $409, unmortgage $198, left $211. If rejected, still never sell NY: even with $48 they can mortgage 3-4 RRs, unmortgage both oranges, and start housing the busiest set. Straight swap leaves me unable to build dark blue and arms them.
